designLanguage.rationale: The concept of a llama capo with a tailored coat, gold epaulettes, and a spit-rifle is both unique and fits the darkly humorous and strange tone of Crawler. The combination of a refined, dignified appearance with the absurdity of a llama and a spit-rifle is well-executed.
